status: runner implemented; inference not yet authorized by resource gate

amendment_history.change: Added a fixed compact key-value representation baseline before any model inference.
amendment_history.rationale: The experiment plan and prior DuoSum v0.4 identify compact key-value as a practical structured-text baseline, with prior evidence that syntax validity and sender-value fidelity differ.

amendment_history.change: Added a hard 12-model-request cap per staged batch, a 30-second per-request timeout, seed-stable episode IDs, and multi-ledger paired reporting.
amendment_history.rationale: The default seven-condition, four-episode plan requires 52 requests, which is an avoidable local resource and runtime burden. Staging bounds each execution and preserves exact episode pairing across ledgers.

hypothesis: Explicit low-overhead codes may reduce measured application-layer communication while preserving exact matching accuracy on a fixed, shared task. This pilot cannot establish general superiority.
task: Role-separated deterministic private-record matching. Sender sees one target tuple; receiver sees a shuffled table of unique candidate tuples. Target index is sampled independently and uniformly.
secondary_outcomes: receiver payload tokenizer count (null unless separately measured)
exact semantic fidelity for mechanically decodable formats

design.message_channel: measured length-prefixed loopback TCP; application-layer envelope, prefix, and acknowledgement counted; TCP/IP/link-layer headers excluded
design.tokenizer_usage: record the sender and receiver tokenizer IDs separately; use provider-reported total prompt/completion counts and do not infer message-only token count from total receiver prompt usage

resource_gate.required: Before any model execution, satisfy all thresholds in experiments/index_v0_3/preregistration.json on the current machine; no remote/cloud inference.
resource_gate.execution_requires: explicit --execute and one shared or separate sender/receiver loopback endpoint(s); redirects and non-loopback hosts are rejected; no batch may exceed 12 planned model requests; each request times out after 30 seconds
resource_gate.staged_execution: Run no_message plus one message protocol at four episodes (12 requests), then add one message protocol at a time (8 requests per batch); run a fresh resource gate before every batch and use a distinct output ledger for every batch.
resource_gate.episode_identity: Episode IDs are derived from generation seeds so batches for the same seed pair and batches for distinct seeds can be combined without collisions.

analysis.frontier: report success against application bytes, reported model tokens, and wall time; do not combine these into a scalar unless a cost model is specified
analysis.claims: No superiority claim from this pilot alone; compare confidence intervals and repeat across model populations and task scales before making general claims.
